title: You own shares yourself
who: Stock held directly or in a brokerage account, such as Schwab, Fidelity, Robinhood or E*Trade.
steps: Before each annual meeting you get a notice or voting form by email or mail.
Find the control number on it. It is usually 16 digits.
Vote at ProxyVote.com or in your broker's app, by phone, or by mail.
Can't find the control number? Ask your broker.

title: You own Vanguard index funds
who: Investors in participating Vanguard U.S. equity index funds. Vanguard says all of its U.S. equity index funds join in early 2027.
steps: Vanguard brokerage clients: log in at vanguard.com and choose a voting policy.
Hold Vanguard funds at another broker? Enroll through ProxyVote.com.
You pick a policy, not a vote on each item. You can change it at any time.

title: You own BlackRock iShares funds
who: Eligible investors in the participating iShares fund in BlackRock's U.S. Retail Program.
steps: There is no separate sign-up page.
If you are eligible, a short voting-policy survey comes with your proxy materials.
Choose one of the listed third-party policies or BlackRock's own.

title: You own Schwab or State Street funds
who: Schwab 1000 Index Fund and ETF holders, and holders of many State Street SPDR index funds.
steps: Schwab: choose a voting policy for the Schwab 1000 Index Fund or ETF through Schwab Asset Management.
State Street: ask your advisor, broker or custodian how to choose a policy for eligible SPDR funds.
Fidelity: no retail voting choice program found as of November 2026.
